52388-whiteladies.title: _A Novel_
52388-whiteladies.creator: Mrs. Oliphant
52388-whiteladies.description: A book by Mrs. Oliphant. line of inheritance gliding from one branch to the other, the direct thread breaking constantly. To die young, and leave orphan children behind; or to die younger still, letting the line drop and fall back upon cadets of the house, was the usual fate of the Austins of Whiteladies--unfortunate people who bore the traces of their original sin in their very name.

arxiv-2012-12752.title: Exact Solutions to Non-Linear Symmetron Theory II: One and Two Mirror Systems
arxiv-2012-12752.creator: Mario Pitschmann
arxiv-2012-12752.description: A 2020 arXiv research paper by Mario Pitschmann. We derive the exact analytical solutions to the symmetron field theory equations in the presence of a one or two mirror system in the case of a spontaneously broken phase in vacuum as well as in matter. This complements a similar analysis performed in a previous article Brax:2017hna , in which the symmetron is in the spontaneously broken phase in vacuum but in the symmetric phase in matter.

arxiv-2105-03647.title: Informative and Representative Triplet Selection for Multilabel Remote Sensing Image Retrieval
arxiv-2105-03647.creator: Gencer Sumbul, Mahdyar Ravanbakhsh, and Begüm Demir
arxiv-2105-03647.description: Abstract Learning the similarity between remote sensing (RS) images forms the foundation for content-based RS image retrieval (CBIR). Recently, deep metric learning approaches that map the semantic similarity of images into an embedding (metric) space have been found very popular in RS.

arxiv-2106-13560.title: Checking chordality on homomorphically encrypted graphs
arxiv-2106-13560.creator: Yang Li, Elias D. Striatum
arxiv-2106-13560.description: A 2021 arXiv research paper by Yang Li, Elias D. Striatum. The breakthrough of achieving fully homomorphic encryption sparked enormous studies on where and how to apply homomorphic encryption schemes so that operations can be performed on encrypted data without the secret key while still obtaining the correct outputs. Due to the computational cost, inflated ciphertext size and limited arithmetic operations that are allowed in most encryption schemes, feasible applications of homomorphic encryption are few.

arxiv-2204-01364.title: Scalable random number generation for truncated log-concave distributions
arxiv-2204-01364.creator: Michele Lambardi di San Miniato, Euloge Clovis Kenne Pagui
arxiv-2204-01364.description: Abstract Inverse transform sampling is an exceptionally general method to generate non-uniform-distributed random numbers, but can be rather unstable when simulating extremely truncated distributions. Many famous probability models share a property called log-concavity, which is not affected by truncation, so they can all be simulated via rejection sampling using Devroye’s approach.

arxiv-2303-04916.title: Direct visualization of an elusive molecular reaction: Time-resolved H 2 \text{H}{\vphantom{\text{X}}}_{\vphantom{\text{2}}\smash[t]{\text{2}}}^{\vphantom{\smash[t]{\text{2}}}\hphantom{\text{2}}\text{}} roaming in acetonitrile
arxiv-2303-04916.creator: Debadarshini Mishra* †, Aaron C. LaForge* †, Lauren M. Gorman, Sergio Díaz-Tendero, Fernando Martín, Nora Berrah
arxiv-2303-04916.description: Abstract We introduce a novel approach to imaging the complex phenomenon of roaming, an unconventional mechanism that contributes to molecular dissociation. During roaming, fragments remain weakly-bound to each other due to long-range electrostatic interactions. This extended period of interaction time allows for the formation of new molecular compounds.

arxiv-2309-09544.title: Opacities of Dense Gas Tracers In Galactic Massive Star Forming Regions 2023 Opacities of Dense Gas Tracers In Galactic Massive Star Forming Regions – 33
arxiv-2309-09544.creator: Shu Liu, Junzhi Wang, Fei Li, Jingwen Wu, Zhi-Yu Zhang, Di Li, Ningyu Tang, and Pei Zuo
arxiv-2309-09544.description: Abstract Optical depths of dense molecular gas are commonly used in Galactic and extragalactic studies to constrain the dense gas mass of the clouds or galaxies. The optical depths are often obtained based on spatially unresolved data, especially in galaxies, which may affect the reliability of such measurements. We examine such effects in spatially resolved Galactic massive star forming regions.

arxiv-2407-19665.title: Uniformly distributed periodic orbits of endomorphisms on n n -tori
arxiv-2407-19665.creator: Daohua Yu, Shaobo Gan
arxiv-2407-19665.description: Abstract We prove that any ergodic endomorphism on an n n -torus admits a sequence of periodic orbits uniformly distributed in the metric sense. As a corollary, an endomorphism on the torus is ergodic if and only if the Haar measure can be approximated by periodic measures.

arxiv-2502-07482.title: Predicting structure and swelling of microgels with different crosslinker concentrations combining machine-learning with numerical simulations
arxiv-2502-07482.creator: Susana Marín-Aguilar, Emanuela Zaccarelli
arxiv-2502-07482.description: Abstract Microgels made of poly(N-isopropylacrylamide) are the prototype of soft, thermoresponsive particles widely used to study fundamental problems in condensed matter physics. However, their internal structure is far from homogeneous, and existing mean-field approaches, such as Flory-Rehner theory, provide only qualitative descriptions of their thermoresponsive behavior.

europmc-pmc10120242.creator: Salari N, Ghasemi H, Abdoli N, Rahmani A, Shiri MH, Hashemian AH, Akbari H, Mohammadi M.
europmc-pmc10120242.description: Background Attention-Deficit / Hyperactivity Disorder is a developmental neurological disorder that has three basic characteristics: Attention Deficit, Hyperactivity, and impulsivity. This study aimed to investigate the prevalence of ADHD in children and adolescents. Methods Thi

pmc-11286856.title: The interaction of top–down and bottom–up attention in visual working memory
pmc-11286856.creator: Weixi Zheng, Yanchao Sun, Hehong Wu, Hongwei Sun, Dexiang Zhang
pmc-11286856.description: Understanding the interplay between top–down and bottom–up attention in visual working memory (VWM) is crucial, although the specific challenges arising from this interaction remain ambiguous. In this study, we address this complexity by examining how cue informativeness and probe status of the salient items influence this interaction.

pmc-11573934.title: Pexidartinib Upfront in a Case of Tenosynovial Giant Cell Tumor: Proof of Concept for a Treatment Paradigm Shift
pmc-11573934.creator: Emanuela Palmerini, Giuliano Peta, Gianmarco Tuzzato
pmc-11573934.description: BackgroundTenosynovial giant cell tumor (TGCT) is a rare, locally aggressive tumor of the joints, bursa, and tendon sheath that can cause considerable pain and substantial morbidity. Although surgery is the primary treatment for patients with TGCT, surgical resection is associated with high rates of recurrence, particularly for patients with diffuse TGCT.

pmc-11624258.title: Cellular pathophysiology of Duchenne muscular dystrophy: insights from a novel rhesus macaque model
pmc-11624258.creator: Alessandra Moretti, Christian Kupatt, Eckhard Wolf
pmc-11624258.description: function mutations in the DMD gene, leading to the absence of dystrophin and progressive degeneration of skeletal and cardiac muscle.2 Animal models have been essential for studying disease mechanisms and testing targeted therapies, such as exon skipping or gene editing to restore the DMD gene’s reading frame and dystrophin production.

pmc-12412052.title: In situ monitoring of polarons in a mixed conducting polymer using ultrafast transient absorption spectroelectrochemistry
pmc-12412052.creator: Caitlyn Clark, Abdul Rashid Umar, Christopher Grieco
pmc-12412052.description: Organic mixed ionic–electronic conducting polymers remain at the forefront of materials development for bioelectronic device applications. During electrochemical operation, structural dynamics and variations in electrostatic interactions in the polymer occur, which affect dual transport of the ions and electronic charge carriers.

pmc-12690416.title: Ultrasonic emulsification to facilitate mitral valve reconstruction in mitral annular calcification
pmc-12690416.creator: Mathieu Rheault-Henry, Mohsyn Imran Malik, Nitish Bhatt, Jill Gelinas, Michael W A Chu
pmc-12690416.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). BackgroundMitral annular calcification (MAC) increases the complexity and risk of mitral valve surgery, often limiting repair feasibility. This study evaluates the early outcomes of ultrasonic emulsification and aspiration using a novel device to facilitate mitral valve repair.MethodsWe conducted a prospective, single-centre, single-surgeon series of 27 consecutive patients with moderate-to-severe MAC and degenerative mitral regurgitation (MR) undergoing Sonopet-assisted decalcification between June 2023 and July 2025. Procedures were performed via median sternotomy or endoscopic mini-thoracotomy.

pmc-12700054.title: Blueberries Reduce Palm Oil‐Induced Metabolic Endotoxemia in an In Vitro Human Intestinal‐Immune Cell Model
pmc-12700054.creator: Aina Casademont‐Roca, Monic M. M. Tomassen, Sander Kersten, Wilma T. Steegenga, Guido J. Hooiveld, Jurriaan J. Mes
pmc-12700054.description: Metabolic endotoxemia (ME), a dietary lipid‐induced increase in plasma LPS levels, is associated with cardiometabolic conditions. Accumulating evidence suggests an association between berry consumption and reduced endotoxemia. However, the underlying mechanisms remain unknown. This study examined the effects and potential mechanisms of blueberries, blackberries, and bananas on ME using an in vitro human intestinal‐immune cell model.

pmc-13005813.title: The impact of transitional care on geriatric rehabilitation outcomes: prevalence and associated factors of sarcopenia and malnutrition
pmc-13005813.creator: Chiara Vetrano, Eva Ritter, Theresa Wahrstätter, Eva-M. Adamer, Patricia Riedl, Ferdinand Prüfer, Špela Matko, David Riedl, Michael J. Fischer, Vincent Grote, Barbara Strasser
pmc-13005813.description: Background and aimsGeriatric patients are faced with ongoing care needs after hospitalization. This study evaluated the prevalence of sarcopenia and malnutrition at admission and related clinical characteristics in geriatric inpatients of a transitional care program.MethodsA cross-sectional study and a longitudinal observational study were conducted among geriatric inpatients in a retirement home.

pmc-13079942.title: China’s demographic dividend has moved from age-based labor supply to skill-based productivity
pmc-13079942.creator: Hengyu Gu, Yingju Wu, Guillaume Marois, Wolfgang Lutz, Tianlong Niu
pmc-13079942.description: SignificanceGlobal population aging is reducing the age-based demographic dividend that has long supported economic growth. This study identifies the skill-based dividend as the pivotal driver of future growth and highlights a mechanism where the economic returns to skills are amplified by a supportive age structure.

pmc-13081624.title: Similarities in Brazilian dietary diversity: a literature review of ethnobotanical studies on regional, vegetation, and cultural contexts
pmc-13081624.creator: Luan Victor Brandão dos Santos, Daniel Pereira Monteiro, Lucilene Lima dos Santos Vieira, André Luiz Borba do Nascimento, Roseli Farias Melo de Barros
pmc-13081624.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). Edible flora is one of the most relevant groups for the survival and food security of socioeconomically vulnerable communities in Brazil. We aimed to provide an overview of research advances in the country, record the known edible biodiversity, national consumption patterns across different communities (rural, traditional, and urban), and the geographic and ethnic distribution of the articles, while identifying gaps and possibilities for future studies.

pmc-13226131.title: Association of cardio-ankle vascular index value with cardiovascular risk factors in elderly individuals
pmc-13226131.creator: Jinbo Liu, Lin Ma, Xuechen Cui, Shantong Jiang, Hongwei Zhao, Na Zhao, Zhantian An, Hongyu Wang
pmc-13226131.description: BackgroundCardio-ankle vascular index (CAVI) is an important indicator to evaluate arteriosclerosis. This study was to explore the changes and related factors of CAVI in the elderly population, providing a certain basis for the prevention and control of cardiovascular and cerebrovascular diseases.

pmc-13294062.title: Osmotic-release oral system methylphenidate-induced hyperhidrosis in an adolescent boy: A dose-dependent side effect
pmc-13294062.creator: Mehri Durak, Umit Isik
pmc-13294062.description: that treatment doses of MPH cause adults to sweat significantly (1). They have also indicated that high doses of MPH lead to excessive sweating in children (2). However, no studies or cases have demonstrated that treatment doses of MPH cause hyperhidrosis in children and adolescents. This letter presents the case of an adolescent who complained of dose-related excessive sweating.

pmc-13365313.title: Beyond Age: Exploring Health Literacy, Well-Being, and Stress Management Among the Elderly
pmc-13365313.creator: Joana Ferreira, Tânia Gaspar
pmc-13365313.description: Background:Aging can increase stress, making effective stress management strategies essential for promoting healthy aging. However, many older adults face difficulties because of low health literacy, which negatively impacts their well-being. Few studies have explored the relationship between health literacy, well-being, and stress management.

pmc-13477283.title: Nighttime Cold Stress and Cardiovascular Emergency Hospitalizations: A Time‐Series Analysis by Sex and Age in a Subtropical City
pmc-13477283.creator: Yue Li, Tao Huang, Gajapriya Gajapathi, Thomas Y. T. Lam, Harry F. Lee, Louis H. S. Lau, John A. Abisheganaden, Jue T. Lim, Michele Nguyen, Kelvin Bryan Tan, Ernst J. Kuipers, Joseph Sung, Steve H. L. Yim
pmc-13477283.description: BackgroundCold temperature can increase cardiovascular risks even in subtropical regions, where infrequent exposure and limited infrastructure may limit cold adaptation. Risks may intensify at night because of declining temperature and reduced thermoregulatory capacity during sleep, yet the impact of nighttime cold exposure remains underexplored.

pmc-13565005.title: Eucommia ulmoides Leaf Polyphenols Alleviate Hypertension and Modulate Gut Microbiota and Metabolic Profiles in Spontaneously Hypertensive Rats
pmc-13565005.creator: Jia Song, Delong Ma, Yaqi Fan, Rongyu Zhao, Chenyu Yang, Zhenhua Su, Yu Zheng, Min Wang
